title: Junior Java Developer
description: We are hiring a junior developer to build internal tools in Java. You will write clean code using OOP principles and solid Data Structures and Algorithms knowledge. Some C++ is a plus. We use Git for version control. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (or currently pursuing one). No professional experience required.

title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Summer internship for students studying Computer Science. Work with our team on performance-critical C++ services and Java tooling on Linux. Strong understanding of Algorithms and Data Structures expected. Must be pursuing a Bachelor's degree. Familiarity with Git and GitHub preferred.

title: Data Science Intern
description: Help our analytics team explore customer data. You will clean datasets with Python and pandas, write SQL queries, and build simple Machine Learning models with scikit-learn. Experience creating dashboards in Tableau is a bonus. Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, or Computer Science.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design and train Deep Learning models for NLP and Computer Vision products. Daily work in Python with PyTorch and TensorFlow, deploying models with Docker on AWS. Requires 2+ years of experience in machine learning engineering and a Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Lead the design of high-traffic payment services. Our backend is written in Java with a REST API layer, PostgreSQL via SQL, and Docker containers running on AWS. You will mentor junior engineers and own system architecture. Requires 5+ years of professional backend experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.

title: Frontend Web Developer
description: Build responsive websites for small business clients using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript and React. You will work closely with designers and use Git for every project. At least 1 year of experience building websites is required.
